text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool here, so I checked each fix by reading it against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing "Emma". I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left `year` as a string. It is now converted with `int(year)`.
